Smart Center 1.0.1

  • When you open Smart Center from the Applications folder, it ejects the disk you installed it from.
  • The installer disk now shows Smart Center next to the Applications folder, with an arrow to drag it.

Smart Center 1.0

The first version of Smart Center: small utilities for your Mac, in one place.

  • Display Corners: round the corners of the displays you choose.
  • Window Tiling: drag a window to an edge or corner of the screen to tile it.
  • Quit on Close: apps quit when you close their last window. You can also require holding ⌘Q to quit.
  • Minimize from Dock and Fill Screen on Click: the Dock icon minimizes, the green button fills the screen.
  • Menu Bar Management: hide the menu bar icons you don’t need.
  • Color Picker, Text Capture, Scratchpad, Camera Preview, Keyboard Cleaning.
  • Keep Awake: on demand, on a schedule, or while an app is open, with a battery limit.
  • Clipboard History: paste again what you copied, or paste as plain text with ⌥⇧⌘V.
  • Control Center and menu bar controls, in English and Italian.

Requires a Mac with Apple silicon and macOS 14 or later. Tested on macOS 27.
